Write a SQL query to get the latest order per user (orders: user_id, created_at).

```sql
SELECT o.*
FROM orders o
JOIN (
  SELECT user_id, MAX(created_at) AS max_created_at
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY user_id
) x
ON x.user_id = o.user_id AND x.max_created_at = o.created_at;
```
